lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately 5-6 horizontal rows of high-luminance circular clusters, forming a semi-regular grid posterior to the branchial region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of increased pixel intensity intersect the horizontal spot rows, most prominent in the mid-flank region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A continuous horizontal ridge feature is visible across the upper third of the flank, defined by a distinct luminance gradient.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Large irregular area of high-luminance pixels located on the lower mid-flank, inconsistent with the surrounding repetitive spot pattern.
other_distinctive_markers: High-density clustering of small high-luminance spots on the anterior dorsal head region and the leading edge of the pectoral fin.
